experiment: Exp 15C: zero-extra-bit HF-INT4-G16 quantizer refinement, exact 64-layer true-causal oracle

meta.gpu_assignment: container-visible xpu:0 backed exclusively by host GPU0 (<card-node> <render-node>); GPU1 was never devices-mapped or selected
meta.reference_validation: Final normalized BF16 hidden states required max_abs_diff==0.0 against exp11_cache.pt and BF16 PPL exactly 7.79822 WT2 / ~=2.374 Code.

quantizer_method.initialization: exact shipped q,u,D_row. Contrary to the prompt shorthand, the measured shipped checkpoint is already coarse-clipped (D*112/amax ratios are not pure 1.0); see shipped_drow_ratio_probe.
quantizer_method.coordinate_descent: 2 iterations; exact weighted D_row closed form, exact q|-8..7 update, exact u|1..16 group update, final exact D_row refit
quantizer_method.msecd: unweighted squared reconstruction error in Had128NoPerm domain
quantizer_method.actmsecd: activation-weighted squared error with c_k=E[R(x)^2], equivalent to minimizing ||(W-What) diag(rms(Rx))||_2^2
quantizer_method.format: 100% hf_int4_g16/1 xe2_dpas_native_v1 q in -8..7, u in 1..16 group16, fp32 D_row; optional fp32 bias_corr; zero extra bytes/bits
quantizer_method.w4a8: FP32 Hadamard activation rotation, per-token absmax/127, RNE int8 activations, exact int8xint8 accumulation, FP32 epilogue

meta.conversion_scope: synchronized in-memory 496-linear unpack+coordinate-refine+dequant+biascorr time, excluding reconstruction-error validation; no checkpoint or packed tensor file was written

mixed_precision_cost.top8_down_selection_metric: largest unweighted MSECD relative reconstruction error in prepass
mixed_precision_cost.note: BF16 bytes are gross bytes for replacement tensors; incremental GiB subtracts the exact q/u/D/bias_corr bits they replace. The prompt's +0.008 GiB small-projection estimate does not match this exact 96-tensor shape arithmetic.

meta.calibration: canonical converter mixed_train rows (1024 WikiText-2 train + 1024 Python-stdlib tokens), pos0 excluded, measured 0/0 six-gram overlap with both exact eval domains

dense_alpha_grid_weightspace_probe.interpretation: The shipped checkpoint is already coarse-MSE-clipped; a 10-point dense alpha grid plus coordinate descent reduces weight reconstruction error by only 0.115-0.205% beyond shipped-initialized coordinate descent on representative large tensors. A full dense-grid causal arm was therefore not a good use of the GPU0 time budget; the exact causal arms measure the shipped-initialized zero-extra-bit coordinate-descent refinement and activation-weighted variant.

down_proj_error_attribution_caution.interpretation: All 64 down_proj relative reconstruction errors lie within a 0.237%-of-mean band, so the top-8 list is nearly tie/noise-selected rather than evidence of sharply sensitive layers.

headline_verdict.conclusion: WT2 already beats TFQ3, but Code remains worse for every zero-extra-bit arm and for the tested expensive BF16-skip Pareto arm.
